name: Cabra de Mora (Spain)
description: Blue field charged towards the hoist with a white sword lying diagonally, over which is a round buckler bearing the bars of Aragon.
history: The flag is a blue cloth of proportion 2/3, with, in the hoist half, a white sword lying diagonally and a buckler over all charged with the Royal Sign of Aragon; published in the Boletín Oficial de Aragón on 17 December 2004.

features.role: sword lying diagonally towards the hoist
round buckler bearing the four red bars
